items.title: Verified against approved requirements
items.pass_criterion: The integrated software is verified against the approved baseline of software requirements.
items.typical_defect: Tests written against a draft or superseded requirements version.

items.title: Measure selection covers normal, boundary and failure
items.pass_criterion: Verification measures and their selection cover normal, boundary and failure behaviour of the requirements.
items.typical_defect: Only nominal scenarios; boundary and failure behaviour unverified.

items.title: Safety functions and target constraints addressed
items.pass_criterion: Safety functions, fault responses and target-specific constraints are addressed by the verification, where applicable.
items.typical_defect: Fault reaction requirement verified only by review, with no executed scenario.

items.title: Requirement coverage by passing tests
items.pass_criterion: Every verification test traces to software requirements, and every software requirement is verified by at least one executed, passing verification test.
items.typical_defect: Requirement with no executed test, or a test tracing to no requirement.

items.title: Trace consistency
items.pass_criterion: Requirements to measures to results traceability is complete and consistent in meaning.
items.typical_defect: Test linked to a requirement but checks a different value or condition.

items.title: Auditable criteria and results
items.pass_criterion: Pass/fail criteria, actual results, regressions and defect status are auditable.
items.typical_defect: Verdicts recorded without expected values or logs; regression status unknown.

items.title: Accurate verification summary
items.pass_criterion: The final verification summary states unverified requirements, hardware and integrity-level gaps accurately and makes no certification or release claim.
items.typical_defect: Summary claims full verification while target or integrity-level gaps remain.
